memory.note: Verified 2026-09-05 on this machine: `claude --help` lists `--add-dir <directories...>`, `--append-system-prompt`, `--model` and `--dangerously-skip-permissions`; ~/.claude/projects/ held 48 project directories with a memory/ subdirectory, keyed by the absolute cwd with every / and . replaced by -.

bootstrap_message: Read {{bootstrap_file}} and follow it exactly. Reply with the single word READY once you have read it and every skill it lists.
notes: Models: fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, or a full model id. Memory is keyed by working directory, so an agent given its own cwd gets its own memory and keeps it across spawns; --add-dir grants tool access to the repo it actually works in. Set auto_approve: true on the agent to add --dangerously-skip-permissions. Coordinator form verified 2026-09-05: `claude --help` lists `--disallowedTools, --disallowed-tools <tools...>` — 'Comma or space-separated list of tool names to deny'. Bash is deliberately NOT denied: the conductor delegates by running ao-topology send/wait/reply, so denying it would break the role. The containment that actually holds for a coordinator is therefore the withheld --add-dir, not this flag. tmux_pattern is the server-side form used by the refresh-client subscription, measured 2026-09-05 against tmux 3.4 on a real Claude input box (`│ > ` matched at its line). It is NOT a translation of `pattern`: tmux searches per line, so `\n` cannot appear; `{`/`}` break the format parser; `:` is the format separator so `[[:space:]]` is unusable; and a trailing `\s` never matches because tmux strips trailing padding. `\s` itself works (glibc extends POSIX ERE). Repo-local override (TM-110): the generic failure list matches the bare word 'authentication', and Claude Code prints '2 MCP servers need authentication' at startup, so a healthy agent was declared a failed candidate in five seconds. Patterns here require failure context. Remove this file once TM-110 lands upstream.
